description: This file defines the 'dBug' class, a PHP utility for dumping and displaying variables in a colored, tabular format with support for various types including arrays, objects, resources, and XML. It includes methods for type checking, recursive display handling, XML parsing, and JavaScript/CSS for toggling display elements.

classes.name: dBug
classes.description: Main class providing variable dumping and display functionalities with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript integration for interactive inspection.

methods.name: dBug
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object and sets up dumping based on variable type and optional forcing string.

methods.name: getVariableName
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the variable name of the dumped variable by analyzing the debug backtrace and source code.

methods.name: makeTableHeader
methods.description: Creates the main HTML table header for a variable dump of a specific type.

methods.name: makeTDHeader
methods.description: Generates a table row with a header cell for a specific variable attribute.

methods.name: closeTDRow
methods.description: Closes a table row in the HTML output.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns an error message for unsupported variable types.

methods.name: checkType
methods.description: Determines the type of the variable and dispatches to the appropriate handler.

methods.name: varIsNULL
methods.description: Outputs 'NULL' for null variables.

methods.name: varIsBoolean
methods.description: Outputs 'TRUE' or 'FALSE' for boolean variables.

methods.name: varIsArray
methods.description: Displays array contents recursively with handling for recursion and empty values.

methods.name: varIsObject
methods.description: Displays object properties and methods, with recursion detection.

methods.name: varIsResource
methods.description: Handles resource variables, including database, GD, and XML resources.

methods.name: varIsDBResource
methods.description: Displays database resource result sets.

methods.name: varIsGDResource
methods.description: Displays properties of GD image resources.

methods.name: varIsXml
methods.description: Handles XML data by treating it as an XML resource.

methods.name: varIsXmlResource
methods.description: Parses XML string or file, rendering its structure and content.

methods.name: xmlParse
methods.description: Parses XML data with PHP's XML parser.

methods.name: xmlStartElement
methods.description: Handles start tags during XML parsing, storing attributes and element names.

methods.name: xmlEndElement
methods.description: Handles end tags, outputting XML node data.

methods.name: xmlCharacterData
methods.description: Handles character data inside XML elements.

methods.name: xmlDefaultHandler
methods.description: Handles miscellaneous XML parsing events like comments.

methods.name: initJSandCSS
methods.description: Outputs JavaScript and CSS for toggling display elements in the HTML dump.
